title: Create meal-plan shopping list generation service
description: Add `CreateShoppingListFromMealPlanService` to load meal plans, resolve referenced recipes, tolerate per-recipe read/parse failures, compute scaling factors, and aggregate scaled recipes with existing aisle infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: `CookbookApp/MealPlans/CreateShoppingListFromMealPlanService.swift` defines the requested service and `CreateError` cases.
The service reads the meal plan through existing helpers, resolves recipe references, parses recipes, and skips failed recipe loads with logging.
Scaling factor uses plan-reference servings divided by recipe metadata servings, defaulting to `1.0` when either side is unavailable or non-serving based.
The service calls `AggregatedShoppingList.aggregate(recipes:aisleConfig:)` with scaled recipes and existing aisle configuration.
